carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge extends along the upper mid-flank, characterized by a sharp intensity transition with higher luminance values on the dorsal aspect and localized shadowing on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A large, high-luminance rectangular patch of depigmented tissue is visible on the flank immediately posterior to the dorsal fin base. The posterior margin of the dorsal fin exhibits irregular tissue loss and notching.
other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is visible swimming in close proximity to the ventral-posterior region of the shark's silhouette.
